canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, no ASCII escaping, string-only leaf values; sort and deduplicate by leaf canonical bytes; no Unicode normalization
merkle: SHA3-256(00 || canonical leaf); SHA3-256(01 || left || right); duplicate last odd node; lexicographic byte order leaves
gaps: Not universal or exhaustive. No completeness claim.
English sense bridges are explicitly labeled, not independently validated translations.
No software OS-kernel equivalence: Polish rdzeń is not automatically jądro systemu.
No inferred IPA/romanization for languages lacking explicit transcription.
Braille only for Polish headword; Morse only lossy ASCII headword.
Full inflection, historical spelling, sign languages, audio and semantic ontology remain incomplete.
Merkle root proves snapshot integrity, NOT linguistic truth, ownership, consensus or PQ signature.
Updating lexical data creates a different content index.
